notes: Every design is drawn by lv_art.py from these parameters: no image, font or logo comes from the game or a third party (text uses Aileron, the CC0 face bundled with Pillow).

One record per design and model: Vehicle.o77_livery_<design>_<model>. The base colour is a VehicleCustomMultilayer (our .mlsetup over the model's own vanilla mask, referenced by path); all artwork is VehicleDecalAttachment entities of this pack.

A template carries at most 12 decals (13 crash the game at spawn, docs/research/vehicles-api.md): lv_plan.py folds a model's decals into their parent panel above that cap, never a part one of the kitFits can hide.

models covers the dealer stock and every other vanilla player body (docs/generated/vehicle-player-scope-2.50.json) with a CrystalCoat unique template to paint over; unsupported says why each other body takes none. A model's trims (records of the same body) take its liveries when they share its AppearancesToColorTemplate and carry every decal panel (lv_plan.py records / trimsRefused).
Company and job names are the Light RP ones (light-rp shared/jobs.lua and the ncmotors dealer); no real-world or Night City brand mark is drawn.
